text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home, Mejiro Ryan and
I pass by
the park where we run into
someone familiar.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ryan! Great timing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I really need your help. Could you
pleaaase lend
me a hand? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Lend a hand? With what?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: With my fans, of course! ☆

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Falco! What are you gonna do
today?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: I wanna hear a new song!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So these girls here are your fans, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm sure making them happy
would fill
you full of joy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well... What am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll do what Umadols do best—a
concert, of
course! Let's put on a show
for these girls, just the
two of us. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It'll really make them smile! Pleaaase,
Ryan! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... They'll be happy, huh? That
sounds
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay, you got it! I'll lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I gotta admit... I'm a little shy for the
songs
you dance to...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry! I know you'll be super
cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And maybe your trainer has some
advice? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Now that's something I can do! I'll show them the power... of being SWOLE!
choice_data_list_en: Let's just think of it as strength training!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not the type of cute I'm talking
about...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: What's that? It sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: H-huh?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uh, anyway! Let's start the music! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And a one, and a two. One, two... Lovely
and
cute—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Lovely and cute, look at those muscles!
Turn
around, and do the bulky muscle
shuffle!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wow, that looks fun! Can I try?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Look at those muscles! The bulky muscle
shuffle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Course you can! Muscles are for
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Th-this isn't what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All four of them work up a nice sweat
underneath
the shining sun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: C-cute?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally gonna start blushing, b-but
I'll try my
best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Just let Falco lead the way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ready?! I'll teach you the perfect song,
Ryan! It'll
be cute and oh-so-lovely!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What?! Cute and lovely?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I guess maybe—wait, what am I saying?!
This is
just too embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Do you all wanna hear a really,
really cute
song?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we do! Give us the cutest there is!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: Wow, I can't wait to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: T-too late to stop now... Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Go, go, Ryan! ♪ Super charming
Ryan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My toes have to point inward? Well, if I
think of it
like training...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
You're so adorable! Super cute and
pretty!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Really?! Hehe, wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan and Falco's concert of cute
is a big
hit with their little fans.
